name: FinalScout - ChatGPT-Driven LinkedIn Emails
description:
Our app offers powerful features to streamline your email prospecting process, including:

1. Click a button to find the email address from any Linkedin profile.
2. Clip a button to write personalized emails for any use case (powered by ChatGPT). 
3. Scrape Linkedin search results (regular or Sales Navigator search) and find emails at scale.
4. Scrape emails from any LinkedIn group.
5. Scrape emails from attendees of any LinkedIn event.
6. Scrape emails from LinkedIn Recruiter search results.
7. Scrape emails from LinkedIn Recruiter pipeline.
8. Scrape employee profiles and emails from a list of company domains.
9. Scrape employee profiles and emails from a list of LinkedIn company pages.
10. Prospect for new clients within finalscout.com if you don't have a Linkedin account. 500 million+ professionals from 20 million+ businesses.
11. Find email address using name and domain name.
12. Find email address for any news article.
13. Emails 100% verified.
14. Export contact details as .csv. 

How does it work?

1. Visit any LinkedIn profile and click the Get email button to find the email address for the LinkedIn profile. Click the Write email button to generate emails using ChatGPT.
2. Search for people on LinkedIn and click the Export emails button at the top to scrape the LinkedIn search results and find LinkedIn emails at scale. 

Who is FinalScout for?

Anyone who needs to connect with anyone in the world will find FinalScout useful! 

In product purchase
The extension provides a certain number of free credits each month. For those in need of more, subscription plans and additional credits are available for purchase directly within the product. For more information and to select the plan that best suits your needs, please visit: https://finalscout.com/plans.
